protocol_A: train on official training partitions, test on official test sets (TON_IoT: stratified 85/15 split of train_test_network)
protocol_B: leave-one-attack-family-out, 22 families, family-level aggregation for statistics
protocol_C: target vs realised FPR on hold-out, official tests and two sub-population shifts; re-calibration windows 250-1000 flows
protocol_D: cost on one CPU thread (CHIDS_NJOBS=1, OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL threads = 1)

protocol_E.deduplication: exact duplicates and label-conflicting vectors removed before any split
protocol_E.host_disjoint: TON_IoT benign test flows from source hosts unseen in fitting and calibration (about 15% of benign flows)

rules: analyst inspection, stop at k' = floor(alpha*(n-a+1)) confirmed benign

drift_monitor.reference: all flows of D_cal2 (unlabeled windows) or its benign flows (benign-only windows)
